name: M6.Character.character_add
statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (q r z : M6.Character.Vector m), M6.Character.character (q+r) z = M6.Character.character q z * M6.Character.character r z
context:
theorem M6.Character.sign_add : ∀ (a b : ZMod 2), M6.Character.sign (a+b) = M6.Character.sign a * M6.Character.sign b := by
  change ∀ (a b : ZMod 2), M6.Character.sign (a + b) = M6.Character.sign a * M6.Character.sign b
  intro a b
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> decide
queries: finite binary character orthogonality sum translation
guidance: Unfold dot, use Pi.add_apply, add_mul, sum_add_distrib, sign_add. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Preserve exact target.
